# Copilot instructions for Pilates Addicts

Please read this file before making any navigation, layout, or styling changes.

- The app is a static single-page experience built with [index.html](../index.html), [script.js](../script.js), [styles.css](../styles.css), and [data.js](../data.js).
- Navigation is driven by category buttons in the left sidebar and a search input that filters the visible items.
- Content opens in the main panel and uses hash-based routing for resource links.
- Keep the current lightweight editorial style: soft neutral surfaces, teal accents, rounded cards, and clear spacing.
- Preserve a calm, professional, content-first feel rather than a flashy or overly app-like interface.
- The preferred look is warm, grounded, and quietly refined: a clean editorial layout with generous breathing room, readable typography, and understated interaction states.
- Keep the main content area feeling structured and calm, with cards that feel like polished teaching materials rather than app-like tiles.
- Preserve the current responsive behavior and avoid major layout rewrites without explicit approval.
- Reuse existing classes and CSS variables rather than introducing unrelated styles.
- Keep interactions simple and understated, with clear hierarchy and readable typography.
- Use teal sparingly as an accent; the experience should feel calm, warm, and grounded.
- When a single item is shown, it should still feel like part of the same polished card-based system, with the same title/body structure and visual rhythm as the multi-card views.
- For single-resource or single-lesson views, prefer a card-like shell that mirrors the collection layout rather than a full-width iframe-only treatment.
- If new preferences about the app’s look, feel, or behavior become clear, update this file so future changes stay consistent.
